DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK ---------------------- At 800 PM MST (0300 UTC), the center of Hurricane Rachel was located near latitude 19.4 North, longitude 111.5 West. Rachel is moving toward the west near 5 mph (7 km/h), and this general motion is expected to continue tonight. A gradual turn toward the west-northwest with an increase in forward speed is expected on Saturday. Maximum sustained winds are near 100 mph (155 km/h) with higher gusts.
